with_retrieval_response: Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days from order confirmation.

no_retrieval_response: I'm sorry, but I don't have information about shipping charges. I recommend checking the website or contacting a human support representative for details on shipping costs.

- Orders ₹499 and below: a flat shipping charge of ₹49 applies.
